$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this file, typically "/schema/loop.json".

iconPath.description: Workspace-relative path to the project icon (e.g. "assets/logo.svg"). Checked before Loop's built-in icon locations.

name.description: Display name for the script, shown in the Loop scripts menu.

command.description: Shell command executed in a Loop terminal at the project root.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the script in the scripts menu. Defaults to "play".

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: When true, the script runs automatically after a worktree is created for a new thread.

previewUrl.description: URL opened in the in-app browser preview when this script runs. Only honored on the desktop build.

autoOpenPreview.description: When true, automatically open the preview panel at `previewUrl` the moment the script starts.

items.description: A project script that team members can import into Loop.

scripts.description: Project scripts shared with everyone who opens this repository in Loop.

title: Loop project file
description: Checked-in project configuration for Loop (loop.json at the repository root). See https://github.com/notshekhar/loop for documentation.
